entry.name: rnbo_hztobeats~
entry.description: Use the hztobeats~ object to convert an incoming number or signal from frequency in hertz (Hz) to beats (quarter notes) using the tempo of the device transport.

arguments.name: hz
arguments.description: The frequency in Hz to be converted to the equivalent time in beats (quarter notes) using the tempo of the device transport.
